text:
deploybot: Alert: hotfix rollout rbld/proxy:20260512-hotfix auto-paused in us-central after spike in 502 responses from edge-router. Rollout state: PAUSED. Logs: https://internal.logs/502/1759998888 :rotating_light:

nora: Copy. What changed in this build? Any schema or connection pooling tweaks?

jon: Small change: increased parallel upstream connections to improve tail latency. We saw it in perf but not at scale.

sre-oncall: Telemetry: 10m window shows +3.0% 5xx in us-central, p95 increased 95ms. Heatmap points to edge-router group A instances.

ops-manager: Ok triage options: 1) full rollback of the rollout 2) regional rollback for us-central 3) route around affected router group then canary patched image. Less blast radius preferred.

nora: Prefer routing around group A then canary the patched config that caps upstream_conns for that group. Jon can we build that quick?

jon: Yes, will build rbld/proxy:20260512-hotfix.1 with upstream_conns=80 for group A only. ETA 18m.

sre-oncall: We can divert group-A traffic immediately. Running: ```
# remove group-A from active pool in us-central
rbctl route update --service=proxy --region=us-central --remove-pool=group-A --add-fallback=group-b --percent=100 --confirm
```

deploybot: Action logged: route update executed by sre-oncall at 2026-05-12T04:01:28Z. Rollout paused.

ops-manager: Good. Once jon pushes the image we'll consider a 5% manual pin to validate. Abort criteria: sustained 5xx > baseline +0.4% for 10m -> rollback to rbld/proxy:20260501-stable.

jon: Patch pushed: rbld/proxy:20260512-hotfix.1 (group-A upstream_conns=80). Requesting manual pin for us-central 5%.

nora: Approving a limited 5% canary for us-central. SRE please ensure the alerting rule is live and pager ready.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. Temporary alert: proxy-502 > baseline+0.4% for 10m -> page. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/proxy/us-central. Pager will escalate.

support: Notifying support and product: @support-team @product :loudspeaker: I'll attach a short blurb for status page.

deploybot: Manual pin command recorded: ```
deploybot pin --image=rbld/proxy:20260512-hotfix.1 --scope=us-central --percentage=5 --reason="cap upstream_conns for group-A" 
```

jon: Starting 5% canary now. Monitoring logs for 502s and connection errors.

sre-oncall: 8m in, no new spike. 18m in, still within baseline. Holding to 30m window before ramp.

nora: Sam will write an internal change note and short release note for external status page. Sam, please include rollback instructions and the change window (now).

support: Draft posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260512-proxy-502-mitigation (short note + support guidance). Change window: 2026-05-12 04:00-05:00 UTC.

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 22m. No new 5xx. Awaiting full 30m.

ops-manager: If 30m is clean we'll ramp to 50% then 100% following standard cadence. If alert fires, immediate rollback target: rbld/proxy:20260501-stable.

jon: 30m reached, metrics green. Initiating ramp to 50% via deploybot.

deploybot: Ramp started: 5% -> 50% in us-central. Next checkpoint scheduled in 15m. :rocket:

nora: Thanks team. We'll run a quick blameless timeline after the rollout completes and track the root cause in the postmortem. Keep updates brief here.
